schatzker — pattern 6

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A high-energy fall produces a complex proximal tibial fracture. CT shows an articular plateau fracture and a separate transverse component that completely disconnects the plateau-metaphyseal segment from the tibial diaphysis. The shaft is no longer continuous with the proximal segment. Which Schatzker type best matches the CT description?

  1. Type II
  2. Type III
  3. Type IV
  4. Type VI
  5. Type I
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Type VI

Type VI: A plateau fracture with metaphyseal-diaphyseal dissociation.

Understanding the options

Type VI
Type VI: A plateau fracture with metaphyseal-diaphyseal dissociation.
Type I
Type I describes a pure split of the lateral tibial plateau without articular depression. The case instead matches Type VI.
Type II
Type II describes a lateral plateau split combined with articular depression. The case instead matches Type VI.
Type III
Type III describes a pure depression of the lateral plateau without a lateral cortical split. The case instead matches Type VI.
Type IV
Type IV describes a fracture involving the medial tibial plateau. The case instead matches Type VI.
